description: This Python source file contains utility functions and classes for handling user login and authentication in a proxy server environment. It provides mechanisms for UI credential retrieval, user authentication with database integration, and creation of login result and UI token objects.

classes.name: LoginResult
classes.description: A data class representing the outcome of an authentication process, including user ID, token key, email, role, and login method.

methods.name: tuple[str,str] get_ui_credentials(master_key: Optional[str])
methods.description: Fetches UI username and password from environment variables or fallback to a master key; raises an exception if credentials are not available.

methods.name: LoginResult authenticate_user( username: str, password: str, master_key: Optional[str], prisma_client: Optional[PrismaClient], )
methods.description: Performs user authentication via email/password or admin credentials, interacts with database, and generates session tokens.

methods.name: ReturnedUITokenObject create_ui_token_object( login_result: LoginResult, general_settings: dict, premium_user: bool, )
methods.description: Constructs a UI token object based on login results, placing security and configuration options into a structured format.
